source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 2.4 says multiple scores can improve a primary target because prompts include programs that excel under different criteria, each representing a different definition of good
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests can show prompt-visible metric-diverse inspiration evidence: declared metric vectors, metric-targeted selection metadata, prompt-context metric filtering, prompt-visible inspiration ids, metric-niche labels, raw and normalized metric values, prompt hash linkage, and metric-diverse inspiration reports with false readiness fields. It does not claim benchmark-required metric-diverse prompt policy, cross-run metric-diverse prompt fixtures, scalar only baseline comparison, single-metric target baseline comparison, equal-budget comparison reports, or AlphaEvolve Section 2.4 benchmark readiness.
